entities.summary: Linda Sobeh Ali is a Palestinian diplomat who has been State of Palestine's Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary for Caribbean Affairs since 2024. She served as Palestine's ambassador to Venezuela from 2012 to 2020.
